title: [review] project-LICHEN-6mij: Clean consolidation with silent semantic change
description:
Code review of b012f03:

**Verification:** The commit correctly consolidates three identical '*_oscore_respond' static functions (in coap_dtn.c, coap_keys.c, coap_server.c) into one shared 'lichen_coap_oscore_respond' in coap_oscore.c, removing ~126 lines of duplicated code while adding the shared function.

**Semantic change (acceptable, not a bug):** The old duplicated functions fell back to calling 'lichen_coap_respond' with the **intended response code** in plaintext when OSCORE protection failed (i.e., they sent the real error code unprotected). The new consolidated function falls back to an **unprotected 5.00 Internal Server Error**. This is documented in the header Doxygen: 'Falls back to an unprotected 5.00 response on protect failure.' From a security perspective this is arguably better (no information leak). No regression.

**Correctness:**
- All callers correctly pass the same arguments they did to the old static functions
- The guard conditions (is_protected && ctx != NULL && piv_len > 0) are correct
- piv_len initialization in keys_single_delete (line 1181, sizeof(piv)=OSCORE_PIV_MAX_LEN) is safe because the guard checks ctx != NULL
- Duplicate includes in coap_keys.c correctly removed
- New function builds a proper CoAP error response (with token, type, message ID copied from request) instead of calling lichen_coap_respond

**No bugs found.**

It is left as an observation that the old fallback leaked the true response code in plaintext; the new 5.00-only fallback is a strict improvement.

No beads filed — clean commit.
